title: Chat
emptyStateDescription: Type a prompt below or choose a model to begin chatting.

composer.visionUnsupportedDetail: “{{model}}” cannot read image attachments. Select a vision-capable model or convert the image/PDF to text first.
composer.attachmentLimitDetail: You can attach up to {{max}} files per message.
composer.tooManyAttachmentsDetail: Only {{added}} of {{requested}} files were added. The limit is {{max}} files per message.
composer.attachmentNotRegistered: Attachment is not registered for promotion.
composer.disabledPlaceholder: Connect an API key to start…
composer.placeholder: Ask anything — Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline. Attach a file to send without text.

nativeErrors.title: Attachment can't be sent
nativeErrors.unsupportedType: This attachment type can't be sent as a native input.
nativeErrors.missingPayload: This attachment is missing its content.
nativeErrors.rawLocalPath: Local file paths can't be sent. Attach the file itself or use a public https:// URL.
nativeErrors.unsupportedFileFormat: Unsupported file type for native input. Allowed: PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, TXT, Markdown, CSV, or JSON. Choose “Local context” instead.
nativeErrors.unsupportedVideoFormat: Unsupported video URL. Use a direct mp4/mpeg/mov/webm link or a YouTube URL.
nativeErrors.tooManyVideoUrls: At most {{max}} video inputs per message (this message has {{actual}}).
nativeErrors.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload as a native file. Use “Local context” instead — it extracts the text into the conversation.
nativeErrors.fileUnavailable: The original file is no longer available — re-attach it to send it as a native file.
nativeErrors.readFailed: Couldn't read this file as a native input.

privacy.e2eeUnavailable: The selected model doesn't advertise E2EE support.
privacy.retentionHint: Venice-only cache hint. Fallback providers ignore it.
privacy.fallbackNotice: Fallback providers are enabled. They cannot preserve E2EE — a chat routed to a fallback provider is sent without E2EE.

memory.disabledTitle: Memory retrieval is disabled in Settings.
memory.loadingTitle: Retrieving relevant memory for this message.
memory.activeTitle: Relevant memory context will be included with this message.
memory.failedTitle: Memory retrieval failed. Your message was sent without memory context.

controls.documentToolsUnavailableTitle: The active model does not support function calling, so tools cannot be sent with this chat.
controls.systemPromptPlaceholder: Optional. Leave empty to avoid adding an app-authored system message.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.hint: Higher effort means deeper reasoning, more tokens, and more latency.
reasoningEffort.unsupported: The selected model doesn't advertise reasoning-effort support.
reasoningEffort.unknownMetadata: Model capabilities aren't available, so reasoning effort won't be sent.
